image_description: A black, wedge-shaped stage monitor loudspeaker featuring a dual-driver configuration on each of its two angled front faces. Each face contains one large circular woofer at the bottom and two smaller circular drivers (likely mid-range or tweeters) arranged horizontally above it. The brand name 'Triton' is visible in white text on the upper right section of the grille.
